hook: Your drive through Nevada passes a rainbow mound that spouts hot water.
title: A Drilling Accident Made This Rainbow Geyser
description:
Fly Geyser in Nevada is a colourful mound that spouts hot water. It exists because of a well drilled in 1964. Minerals from the water built the mound, and algae gave it those bright colours.

#Shorts #Geography #Places

scenes.narration: A rainbow-coloured mound spouts hot water.
scenes.headline: RAINBOW GEYSER

scenes.narration: It is Fly Geyser, in Nevada.
scenes.headline: FLY GEYSER, NEVADA

scenes.narration: And nature did not start it.
scenes.headline: NATURE DIDN'T START IT

scenes.narration: In 1964, people drilled a well here.
scenes.headline: DRILLED IN 1964

scenes.narration: The water kept erupting, year after year.
scenes.headline: IT NEVER STOPPED

scenes.narration: Minerals in the water built this mound.
scenes.headline: MINERALS BUILT IT

scenes.narration: Algae gave it those bright colours.
scenes.headline: ALGAE COLOURS

scenes.narration: A drilling accident made this wonder.
scenes.headline: BORN FROM AN ACCIDENT
